facts.text: Kořist chytá střemhlavým útokem z letu.
facts.quote: catches its prey by flying above the ground at about ten metres (11 yd) and dropping swiftly on any suitable prey it finds
it catches mudskippers, crabs, fish and worms
stealing food items from other species of birds

facts.text: Hnízdo tvoří jen jednoduchá jamka v zemi.
facts.quote: its nest being a simple scrape in the ground
